ideas.pitch: An automated data cleaning, profiling, and feature engineering wrapper tailored for rapid tabular Kaggle competitions under extreme time pressure.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview: Build your model. Climb the leaderboard. Adapt when the challenge changes. Can you clean messy data, identify useful features...
ideas.title: CleanSweep ML Pipeline & Automated Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the automated data profiling and preprocessing pattern seen in DataVeritas to squeeze out a few critical percentage points on the leaderboard during the 48-hour qualifier.

ideas.pitch: A real-time monitoring tool designed for the live finale to instantly detect distribution shifts, missing columns, and concept drift when surprise task changes hit.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: The Live Finale | Qualifying teams face an offline challenge at PCCOE, Pune, where evolving datasets and surprise task changes will test their technical skills, creativity and adaptability.
ideas.title: AdaptML: Dynamic Feature Drift & Schema Shift Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the primary evaluation criterion of Round 2—adaptability when new information and changing datasets disrupt the baseline model.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance gradient boosting pipeline integrated with automated SHAP explanations and fairness checks to satisfy both leaderboard metrics and live Q&A scrutiny.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview: Build your model. Climb the leaderboard. Adapt when the challenge changes. A strong model is only the beginning... explain the decisions behind your approach.
ideas.title: Explainable Tabular Booster with SHAP & Bias Guards
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high predictive accuracy with clinical-grade explainability, directly mirroring the 1st place winning strategy of patient-readmission-prediction.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight CLI and dashboard tool for solo or duo teams to rapidly cross-validate, blend multi-model outputs, and securely generate reproducible Kaggle submission files.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: The Online Qualifier | Take on a 48-hour machine learning challenge on Kaggle using the provided datasets... Deliverables: Prediction file and reproducible source code.
ideas.title: Kaggle-in-a-Box: Rapid Ensemble & Submission Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the logistical overhead of 48-hour hackathons, allowing small teams to focus strictly on feature engineering and model tuning rather than boilerplate orchestration.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent coding assistant agent specialized in generating automated feature extraction scripts and data imputation strategies for messy tabular datasets.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview: Can you clean messy data, identify useful features, evaluate your approach and adapt when new information changes the task?
ideas.title: MetaEnsemble: LLM-Assisted Feature Engineering Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses advanced prompt-to-code iteration patterns seen in winning metacognition and AI engineering hacks to accelerate tabular problem-solving under strict time constraints.
